rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE (Trial paywall on fresh provider): newly created service_provider organisations are being routed through the standard trial-expiry gate without a valid trial window, so the Service Desk page renders TrialEndedGate instead of the desk. Fix: when creating an org in routes/service_provider.signup, either set is_trial=false (provider self-serve plan) or seed trial_ends_at sufficiently in the future, OR exclude account_type='service_provider' from the trial-ended gate component. Reproduction: POST /api/service-provider/signup → complete /service-desk/setup wizard → land on /service-desk → see 'Your free trial has ended' card.
